windowsWatcherRegression.scenario: Live API and frontend remained healthy while a generated output file was exclusively locked.

windowsLauncher.scenario: START-STOCKSENSE.cmd started the API on port 4000 and Vite on port 5173 using its own project directory.

additionalConfirmedFixes: Duplicate query parameters previously reached SQLite as arrays and produced 500; scalar bounded query validation now returns 400.
Login previously accepted suffixes beyond bcrypt's 72-byte boundary; overlong UTF-8 password inputs now return 400 without a session.
Canceled operations left warehouse reports in actionable review counts; effective canceled report status, open-operation queues and closed-review guards now preserve consistent workflow state.

Fresh demo history previously recorded nonchronological before/after balances and omitted historical operation locations; seeding now orders movements chronologically and links both warehouses. Existing audit history is preserved.
Windows packaging could crash Vite on a locked output ZIP; generated outputs, work artifacts and data directories are now excluded from watching, with a successful targeted live file-lock regression.
dataSafety: All database-writing suites and the receipt walkthrough used isolated databases and dedicated test ports. Separate startup/watcher checks inspected the live development app without resetting or rewriting its inventory.
limits: Passing these checks is not an external penetration test or a guarantee that no defect exists.
External OpenAI and Resend delivery were disabled in tests; real credentials and provider delivery still require deployment validation.
SQLite is a single-node deployment; TLS, backup/restore validation, monitoring and capacity testing remain deployment responsibilities.
MFA, SSO, PostgreSQL/high availability, valuation, barcode/photo workflows and transit transfers are outside the implemented scope.
Browser automation uses Chromium; automated accessibility coverage does not replace assistive-technology and broader cross-browser testing.
Existing demo databases retain their earlier sample audit history; the corrected chronological seed applies to fresh isolated databases or an explicitly requested demo reset.
